description:
Business overview calculated by iDoklad. All amounts are in the company's home currency (usually CZK). Reports:
- revenue_by_period: issued (income) and received (costs) invoice totals per month, quarter or year, with paid/unpaid split.
- year_comparison: this year's totals against last year's.
- overdue_aging: overdue amounts by age (1–30, 31–60, 61–90, 90+ days), for receivables (customers owe you) and payables (you owe suppliers).
- vat: VAT on output and input for the current and previous VAT period (VAT payers).
- vat_registration_limit: this calendar year's sales against the CZ VAT registration limit (for companies not yet registered for VAT).
- document_counts: how many invoices, contacts and other documents the company has.

period.description: For revenue_by_period and vat (vat: month or quarter only).

periods.description: For revenue_by_period: how many periods back, including the current one. Default 12 months, 4 quarters or 3 years.
